system.description: You can send a one-way telepathic message lasting about a minute. You must have at least seen the target before, and they must be on the same planet as you. The target recognizes the contact as a telepathic message and may recognize your mental “voice.” Effort: Increase the range to anywhere in the same star system. Increase the range to anywhere in the same galaxy (this requires three levels of Effort). Action to initiate.
